_note: Procedural entries of the empty ground list (scenes/empty_ground/stage.gd), the scenarios the two old review scenes showed (merged into the empty ground 2026-09-27). dt: simulation step (s). movers: id -> {kind (dog | leash | rider | pigeon), label (list text), cycle (s, then it starts over), frame (view height, m), follow (the camera follows it), and the scenario}. dog: speeds [[until s, m/s]...], turnAmplitude (rad), turnFrequency (rad/s). leash: walkUntil (s, then stands), turnAmplitude, turnFrequency. rider: vehicle (type), cruise (m/s), pedalUntil (s, then coasts), yawRateAmplitude (rad/s), yawRateFrequency. pigeon: walkUntil + walkSpeed, peck [from, to] + peckSpeed, hops (s), hopDistance (m), fly [from, to] + flySpeed + circleRate (rad/s) + altitude (m), wanderAmplitude + wanderFrequency; grid: ground lines every this many metres; lookAt (s) + lookHeight (m): a fixed view at where it is then (pigeon_fly). grid: the ground lines (colour, half size m, width m). dog and leash draw the model dog chosen in the panel (npc/animal-models.json). animals: species -> {label}; the list shows the scenarios walk, trot, behaviour and every action animal-models.json gives the species (timing in the review block of npc/animal-behaviour.json).
